assignedReviews.card_evidence: How many basic tastes can your tongue sense?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify from pictures and labeled diagrams the parts of the digestive system as mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine, and large intestine, and describe how they work
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about the five basic tastes sensed by the tongue. It does not identify or describe any parts of the digestive system (mouth, gullet, stomach, small intestine, large intestine) or how they work. Taste is a sensory function, not a digestive process.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: How many basic tastes can your tongue sense?
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses taste perception, not the functioning of any human body system (muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, respiratory). It provides no information about how these systems work, so it does not support this competency.

copy.en:
How many basic tastes can your tongue sense?

Five! Sweet, salty, sour, bitter, and umami (savory, like broth or meat) — every flavor is a mix of these.
copy.tl:
Ilang lasa ang nararamdaman ng dila?

Lima! Matamis, maalat, maasim, mapait, at umami (malinamnam, tulad ng sabaw o karne) — lahat ng lasa ay halo ng mga ito.
copy.bis:
Pila ka lami ang mabati sa dila?

Lima! Tam-is, parat, aslom, pait, ug umami (lami sama sa sabaw o karne) — ang tanang lami sagol niini.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Too little growth hormone makes a child grow less tall
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses growth hormone effects on height, which pertains to the endocrine system. G4-L-1 requires describing the muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory systems. Growth hormone is not part of any of these systems, and the card provides no information about them.

copy.en:
What does growth hormone do to height?

Too little growth hormone makes a child grow less tall, while too much can make a child grow very tall.
copy.tl:
Ano ang epekto ng growth hormone sa taas?

Kapag kulang ang growth hormone, hindi gaanong tumataas ang bata; kapag sobra, maaari itong maging napakataas.
copy.bis:
Unsa ang epekto sa growth hormone sa gitas-on?

Kon kulang ang growth hormone, dili kaayo motaas ang bata; kon sobra, mahimong taas kaayo kini.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Too much sugar from candy and soft drinks damages teeth and can cause weight and health problems
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses the health effects of excessive sugar consumption (tooth damage, weight problems). It does not describe how any human body system (muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, respiratory) works, nor does it provide information needed to perform that competency.

copy.en: Too much sugar from candy and soft drinks damages teeth and can cause weight and health problems — eat it only in small amounts.
copy.tl: Ang sobrang asukal mula sa kendi at softdrinks ay nakakasira ng ngipin at maaaring magdulot ng problema sa timbang at kalusugan — dapat kaunti lang.
copy.bis: Ang sobrang asukal gikan sa kendi ug softdrinks makadaot sa ngipon ug mahimong hinungdan og problema sa timbang ug panglawas — gamay lang ang angay kaonon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the metal parts act as conductors to carry heat or electricity
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the process of photosynthesis and respiration, and identify its raw materials needed and products
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses conductors and insulators in tools, which is unrelated to photosynthesis and respiration. It provides no information about the process, raw materials, or products of photosynthesis/respiration.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the metal parts act as conductors to carry heat or electricity
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: using information from secondary sources identify the different parts of the cell where photosynthesis and respiration occur
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about heat/electricity conduction and insulation, not about cell parts where photosynthesis and respiration occur. No support for this competency.

copy.en: In tools like flat irons, tongs, wires, and spatulas, the metal parts act as conductors to carry heat or electricity, while the rubber or plastic parts act as insulators to protect your hand.
copy.tl: Sa mga gamit tulad ng flat iron, sipit, wires, at spatula, ang mga parte na metal ay nagsisilbing conductor para magdala ng init o kuryente, habang ang mga parte na rubber o plastic ay insulator para protektahan ang iyong kamay.
copy.bis: Sa mga galamiton sama sa flat iron, kimpit, wires, ug spatula, ang mga parte nga metal nagsilbi nga conductor aron magdala sa init o kuryente, samtang ang mga parte nga rubber o plastic insulator aron panalipdan ang imong kamot.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Common tools for measuring volume include beakers, graduated cylinders, measuring cups, measuring spoons, and droppers.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: plan and carry out a scientific investigation to determine the effect of different surfaces on the size of frictional forces
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes tools for measuring volume, which is unrelated to planning or carrying out an investigation about the effect of different surfaces on frictional forces. No content supports the friction competency.

copy.en: Common tools for measuring volume include beakers, graduated cylinders, measuring cups, measuring spoons, and droppers.
copy.tl: Ang mga karaniwang tools sa pagsukat ng volume ay beaker, graduated cylinder, measuring cup, measuring spoon, at dropper.
copy.bis: Ang mga kasagarang tools sa pagsukod sa volume mao ang beaker, graduated cylinder, measuring cup, measuring spoon, ug dropper.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A toothache can be a warning sign — it might mean a cavity or infection that a dentist needs to treat.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe in simple terms how the following human body systems work: muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, and respiratory
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses toothache as a sign of dental cavity or infection, which is unrelated to the muscular, skeletal, digestive, circulatory, or respiratory systems described in G4-L-1.

copy.en:
Why might a toothache matter?

A toothache can be a warning sign — it might mean a cavity or infection that a dentist needs to treat.
copy.tl:
Bakit importante ang sakit ng ngipin?

Ang pananakit ng ngipin ay maaaring tanda na may butas o impeksyon na kailangang gamutin ng dentista.
copy.bis:
Nganong hinungdanon ang sakit sa ngipon?

Ang sakit sa ngipon mahimong timaan nga adunay lungag o impeksyon nga kinahanglan tambalan sa dentista.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Topography is the shape of the land, and places that are high up, like Baguio, are usually colder than lowlands.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to explain how lines of evidence, such as fossils, biogeography, and comparative morphology, support the occurrence of evolution
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains topography and its effect on temperature (altitude/climate). The competency G10-L-5 requires explaining how lines of evidence (fossils, biogeography, comparative morphology) support evolution. The card provides no information about evolution or any of its evidence, so it is unrelated to the assigned competency.

copy.en: Topography is the shape of the land, and places that are high up, like Baguio, are usually colder than lowlands.
copy.tl: Ang topography ay ang hugis ng lupa, at ang mga lugar na mataas, tulad ng Baguio, ay kadalasang mas malamig kaysa sa mabababang lugar.
copy.bis: Ang topography mao ang porma sa yuta, ug ang mga lugar nga taas, sama sa Baguio, kasagarang mas bugnaw kay sa mga patag.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: To find the total magnification, multiply the eyepiece power by the objective power
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify local impacts of global climate change and suggest ways that individuals can do to reduce the impact of global warming
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches microscope total magnification calculation, which has no connection to global climate change impacts or reducing global warming.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: To find the total magnification, multiply the eyepiece power by the objective power
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: recognize that there is a need to protect and conserve the environment for living things to survive
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about microscope magnification, not about protecting or conserving the environment for living things to survive.

copy.en: Total magnification is calculated by multiplying the eyepiece magnification by the objective lens magnification, such as 10x times 40x equals 400x.
copy.tl: Ang total magnification ay kinukuha sa pamamagitan ng pagmu-multiply ng magnification ng eyepiece sa magnification ng objective lens, tulad ng 10x times 40x equals 400x.
copy.bis: Ang total magnification makuha pinaagi sa pag-multiply sa magnification sa eyepiece sa magnification sa objective lens, sama sa 10x times 40x equals 400x.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Cigarette smoke contains toxic chemicals like arsenic and lead
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify some useful things that people have made from non-living materials and describe what natural materials have been used to make the items
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes harmful toxins in cigarette smoke, which is unrelated to identifying useful things made from non-living materials or the natural materials used to make them. The competency is about useful products from earth materials, not health hazards.

copy.en: Cigarette smoke contains toxic chemicals like arsenic and lead, plus oxidizing chemicals that damage the cells of your lungs and blood vessels.
copy.tl: Ang usok ng sigarilyo ay may nakalalasong kemikal tulad ng arsenic at lead, pati na oxidizing chemicals na sumisira sa mga selula ng baga at ugat ng dugo.
copy.bis: Ang aso sa sigarilyo adunay makahilong kemikal sama sa arsenic ug lead, apil na ang oxidizing chemicals nga makadaot sa mga selula sa baga ug ugat sa dugo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Traditional biotechnology includes selective breeding of animals with their best qualities and fermentation to make cheese, yogurt, and beer.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe some effects of weather disturbances that occur in or near the Philippines
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses traditional biotechnology (selective breeding and fermentation), which is unrelated to weather disturbances in or near the Philippines. No content supports describing effects of weather disturbances.

copy.en: Traditional biotechnology includes selective breeding of animals with their best qualities and fermentation to make cheese, yogurt, and beer.
copy.tl: Kasama sa traditional biotechnology ang selective breeding ng mga hayop na may pinakamagandang katangian at ang fermentation para makagawa ng keso, yogurt, at beer.
copy.bis: Lakip sa traditional biotechnology ang selective breeding sa mga mananap nga adunay labing maayong mga kinaiya ug ang fermentation aron makahimo og keso, yogurt, ug beer.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Transcription is the process where DNA in the nucleus is copied into messenger RNA
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: investigate the effects of static electricity using common materials, such as a comb, plastic and glass rods, and balloons
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes DNA transcription in the nucleus, a molecular biology topic. The assigned competency G5-F-7 is about investigating static electricity with common materials. There is no overlap in subject matter; the card does not support the competency in any way.

copy.en: Transcription is the process where DNA in the nucleus is copied into messenger RNA, or mRNA, so the genetic message can leave the nucleus.
copy.tl: Ang transcription ay proseso kung saan ang DNA sa nucleus ay kinokopya bilang messenger RNA, o mRNA, para makalabas ng nucleus ang genetic message.
copy.bis: Ang transcription mao ang proseso diin ang DNA sa nucleus gikopya isip messenger RNA, o mRNA, aron ang genetic message makagawas sa nucleus.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: During elongation, tRNA molecules keep bringing amino acids to the ribosome
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how soil is formed from rocks and minerals
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes translation elongation in protein synthesis, a molecular biology topic. G5-E-4 requires explaining how soil is formed from rocks and minerals, which is an earth science topic. There is no overlap in subject matter.

copy.en: During elongation, tRNA molecules keep bringing amino acids to the ribosome, and each amino acid is transferred to the growing polypeptide chain as the ribosome moves along the mRNA.
copy.tl: Sa elongation, patuloy na dinadala ng tRNA molecules ang amino acids sa ribosome, at bawat amino acid ay inililipat sa lumalaking polypeptide chain habang gumagalaw ang ribosome sa mRNA.
copy.bis: Sa elongation, ang tRNA molecules padayong nagdala sa amino acids sa ribosome, ug matag amino acid ibalhin sa nagtubo nga polypeptide chain samtang molihok ang ribosome sa mRNA.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Transmission lines carry electricity at high voltage from the power plant to a substation over long distances.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: participate in guided investigations to infer the relationship among current, voltage, and resistance in assembled series and parallel circuits with varying number of loads and battery
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes high-voltage power transmission from a power plant to a substation. G9-F-7 requires guided investigations to infer the relationship among current, voltage, and resistance in assembled series and parallel circuits with varying loads and battery. The card does not address circuits, current, voltage, resistance relationships, or any investigation. It is unrelated to the competency's content and actually aligns more closely with G10-F-9 (high voltage electricity distribution).

copy.en: Transmission lines carry electricity at high voltage from the power plant to a substation over long distances.
copy.tl: Ang transmission lines ay nagdadala ng kuryente sa mataas na voltage mula sa power plant papunta sa substation sa malalayong distansya.
copy.bis: Ang transmission lines nagdala og kuryente sa taas nga voltage gikan sa power plant padulong sa substation sa lagyong distansya.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The rate of transpiration gets higher with higher temperatures
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify issues and concerns in the local community and how they could be addressed by science, such as the treatment of waste
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a plant physiological process (transpiration rate vs. temperature). G4-M-6 requires identifying local community issues/concerns and how science addresses them, such as waste treatment. There is no connection to community issues or science-based solutions.

copy.en: The rate of transpiration gets higher with higher temperatures, so plants release more water vapor on hot days.
copy.tl: Ang rate ng transpiration ay tumataas kapag mas mataas ang temperatura, kaya mas maraming water vapor ang inilalabas ng mga halaman sa mainit na araw.
copy.bis: Ang rate sa transpiration mosaka kon mas taas ang temperatura, mao nga mas daghan ang water vapor nga gipagawas sa mga tanom sa init nga mga adlaw.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Improper waste disposal pollutes the air
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify gravity as a non-contact force that affects the behaviors of materials and objects on Earth in predictable ways
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses air pollution from improper waste disposal, with no mention of gravity, non-contact forces, or any physics content related to G5-F-4.

copy.en: Improper waste disposal pollutes the air when rotting trash releases bad-smelling gases that spread through the neighborhood.
copy.tl: Ang improper waste disposal ay nagpaparumi sa hangin kapag ang nabubulok na basura ay naglalabas ng mabahong gas na kumakalat sa buong lugar.
copy.bis: Ang improper waste disposal naghugaw sa hangin kon ang nagkadunot nga basura magpagawas og baho nga gas nga mokatap sa tibuok lugar.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tuberculosis is treated with a 6 to 12-month course of medication
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify the role of greenhouse gases in enhanced global warming and climate change
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about tuberculosis treatment, which is unrelated to the role of greenhouse gases in global warming and climate change. No instructional support for the competency.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tuberculosis is treated with a 6 to 12-month course of medication
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain how energy from the Sun interacts with the atmosphere
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about tuberculosis treatment, which is unrelated to how energy from the Sun interacts with the atmosphere. No instructional support for the competency.

copy.en: Tuberculosis is treated with a 6 to 12-month course of medication, along with rest and hydration, and sometimes supplemental oxygen.
copy.tl: Ang tuberculosis ay ginagamot sa pamamagitan ng 6 hanggang 12 buwang gamutan, kasama ang pahinga at pag-inom ng maraming likido, at kung minsan ay supplemental oxygen.
copy.bis: Ang tuberculosis gitambalan pinaagi sa 6 hangtod 12 ka bulan nga pag-inom ug tambal, uban sa pahulay ug pag-inom ug daghang pluwido, ug usahay supplemental oxygen.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: deep ocean trenches and underwater volcanoes also form as plates interact
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: compare the relative wavelengths and frequencies of different types of electromagnetic waves, including radio waves, microwaves, infrared, visible light, ultra-violet, x-rays, and gamma radiation
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes geological features formed by plate interactions (trenches and underwater volcanoes). G9-F-11 is about comparing wavelengths and frequencies of electromagnetic waves. There is no connection to electromagnetic waves, wavelengths, or frequencies.

copy.en: In areas with active volcanoes, geographical changes like deep ocean trenches and underwater volcanoes also form as plates interact.
copy.tl: Sa mga lugar na may aktibong bulkan, nabubuo rin ang mga malalim na trench sa karagatan at mga bulkan sa ilalim ng dagat habang nakikipag-ugnayan ang mga plate.
copy.bis: Sa mga lugar nga adunay aktibong bolkan, maporma usab ang mga lawom nga trench sa dagat ug mga bolkan sa ilawom sa dagat samtang mag-interact ang mga plate.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: The triangulation method uses the time difference between S-wave and P-wave arrivals at three seismic stations to locate an earthquake's epicenter.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify some of the basic characteristics used to describe the weather, such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, rain, and cloud cover
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches how to locate an earthquake epicenter using seismic wave arrival times, which is unrelated to identifying weather characteristics such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, humidity, rain, or cloud cover. The content does not support the competency in any way.

copy.en: The triangulation method uses the time difference between S-wave and P-wave arrivals at three seismic stations to locate an earthquake's epicenter.
copy.tl: Ginagamit ng triangulation method ang pagkakaiba ng oras ng pagdating ng S-wave at P-wave sa tatlong seismic stations upang matukoy ang epicenter ng lindol.
copy.bis: Ang triangulation method mogamit sa kalainan sa oras sa pag-abot sa S-wave ug P-wave sa tulo ka seismic stations aron matultolan ang epicenter sa linog.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: the average speed is 70 kilometers per hour
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe using labeled diagrams the biotic and abiotic features of tropical rainforests, swamps, estuaries, mangrove forests, and coral reefs
assignedReviews.reason: The card is a physics/math problem about calculating average speed from distance and time. G9-L-9 requires describing biotic and abiotic features of specific Philippine ecosystems using labeled diagrams. There is no connection to living things, ecosystems, or labeled diagrams.

copy.en: If an odometer reads zero at the start of a trip and 35 kilometers half an hour later, the average speed is 70 kilometers per hour.
copy.tl: Kung ang odometer ay zero sa simula ng biyahe at 35 kilometers makalipas ang kalahating oras, ang average speed ay 70 kilometers per hour.
copy.bis: Kung ang odometer zero sa sinugdanan sa biyahe ug 35 kilometers pagkahuman sa tunga sa oras, ang average speed kay 70 kilometers per hour.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Scientific investigations must be valid and reliable so that the results can be trusted and used to answer the question fairly.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify examples of everyday situations that demonstrate: a. kinetic energy being transformed to potential energy, and b. potential energy being transformed to kinetic energy
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses validity and reliability of scientific investigations, with no mention of kinetic or potential energy transformations. It does not support the competency in any way.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Scientific investigations must be valid and reliable so that the results can be trusted and used to answer the question fairly.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe kinetic energy as the movement of objects or particles, and potential energy as energy stored due to the position of objects or particles
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about scientific investigation validity and reliability, not about kinetic energy as movement or potential energy as stored by position. No direct or prerequisite support for this energy competency.

copy.en: Scientific investigations must be valid and reliable so that the results can be trusted and used to answer the question fairly.
copy.tl: Ang mga scientific investigation ay dapat maging valid at reliable para ang mga resulta ay mapagkakatiwalaan at magamit sa patas na pagsagot sa tanong.
copy.bis: Ang mga scientific investigation kinahanglang mahimong valid ug reliable aron ang mga resulta kasaligan ug magamit sa patas nga pagtubag sa pangutana.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: In tsunami alert simulations, students act out roles like local authorities, emergency responders, and community members to practice warning procedures and evacuation coordination.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain the difference between heat and temperature
assignedReviews.reason: The card describes a tsunami alert simulation and evacuation coordination, which has no connection to the competency 'explain the difference between heat and temperature'. The content is unrelated to heat and temperature concepts.

copy.en: In tsunami alert simulations, students act out roles like local authorities, emergency responders, and community members to practice warning procedures and evacuation coordination.
copy.tl: Sa tsunami alert simulations, ginagampanan ng mga estudyante ang mga papel tulad ng local authorities, emergency responders, at community members para sanayin ang warning procedures at koordinasyon sa paglikas.
copy.bis: Sa tsunami alert simulations, gidula sa mga estudyante ang mga papel sama sa local authorities, emergency responders, ug community members aron magbansay sa warning procedures ug koordinasyon sa pagbakwit.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tsunamis are not single waves but a series of ocean waves that can surge over 100 feet
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Tsunami wave height is earth science, not plant reproduction.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: a series of ocean waves that can surge over 100 feet
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: plan a simple scientific investigation that includes the features of a fair test, replication, and accurate measurement to determine which type of plant propagation, such as cutting, budding, layering, grafting, works best for garden plants
assignedReviews.reason: Tsunami height is not planning a fair test of plant-propagation methods.

copy.en: Tsunamis are not single waves but a series of ocean waves that can surge over 100 feet, about as tall as a ten-story building, onto land.
copy.tl: Ang tsunami ay hindi iisang alon kundi sunod-sunod na alon sa dagat na maaaring umabot ng mahigit 100 talampakan, halos kasing taas ng sampung palapag na gusali, papunta sa lupa.
copy.bis: Ang tsunami dili usa ka balod kondili sunod-sunod nga balod sa dagat nga makaabot ug kapin sa 100 ka tiil, halos sama kataas sa napulo ka andana nga bilding, padulong sa yuta.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: before an earthquake
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: identify some of the basic characteristics used to describe the weather, such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, rain, and cloud cover
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches turning off gas, water, and electricity before an earthquake, which is earthquake preparedness content. G4-E-4 requires identifying weather characteristics such as air temperature, air pressure, wind speed, wind direction, humidity, rain, and cloud cover. The card provides no information about weather characteristics and is unrelated to the competency.

copy.en: Learn how to turn off the gas, water, and electricity in your home before an earthquake.
copy.tl: Alamin kung paano patayin ang gas, tubig, at kuryente sa bahay bago pa man lumindol.
copy.bis: Hibaloi kon unsaon pagpalong ang gas, tubig, ug kuryente sa balay sa dili pa molinog.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Diploid organisms, like humans, have two alleles at each genetic locus
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: demonstrate various techniques in separating mixtures, such as decantation, winnowing, scooping, picking, evaporation, filtering, sieving, and using magnets
assignedReviews.reason: The card teaches genetics (alleles, inheritance in diploid organisms), which is unrelated to the competency on separating mixtures (decantation, winnowing, filtering, etc.).

copy.en: Diploid organisms, like humans, have two alleles at each genetic locus, one inherited from the mother and one from the father.
copy.tl: Ang mga diploid organism, tulad ng tao, ay may dalawang alleles sa bawat genetic locus, isa mula sa ina at isa mula sa ama.
copy.bis: Ang mga diploid organism, sama sa mga tao, adunay duha ka alleles sa matag genetic locus, usa nga napanunod sa inahan ug usa sa amahan.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: matter always occupies space
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the indicators for a chemical reaction as color change, the formation of a precipitate, the release of gas, and or odor, or a change in temperature
assignedReviews.reason: The card explains that matter occupies space and two objects cannot share the same space. It contains no information about indicators of chemical reactions such as color change, precipitate formation, gas release, odor, or temperature change.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: matter always occupies space
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: explain that the formation of new bonds or the breaking of existing bonds constitutes a chemical change and the formation of a new substance
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses matter occupying space, not the formation or breaking of chemical bonds or the creation of a new substance. It does not support the competency about chemical change.

copy.en:
Can two objects occupy the same space at the same time?

No! One object must move away before another object can take its place, because matter always occupies space.
copy.tl:
Maaari bang magkasama ang dalawang bagay sa iisang space nang sabay?

Hindi! Kailangang umalis muna ng isang bagay bago makapasok ang isa pa, dahil laging may sinasakop na space ang matter.
copy.bis:
Mahimo bang magdungan ang duha ka butang sa usa ra ka space?

Dili! Kinahanglang mobiya una ang usa ka butang sa dili pa makasulod ang lain, kay ang matter kanunay adunay giokupar nga space.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Angiosperm seeds, like beans, typically have two cotyledons
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe changes of state for solids, liquids, and gases as melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation using diagrams and flowcharts
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses seed structure (cotyledons, endosperm) in angiosperms, which is plant biology, not changes of state of matter (melting, evaporation, freezing, condensation). No support for G6-M-1.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Angiosperm seeds, like beans, typically have two cotyledons
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe how changes in temperature cause matter to change in state, such as solid to liquid to gas
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about seed anatomy, not about how temperature changes cause matter to change state. No relation to G5-M-6.

copy.en: Angiosperm seeds, like beans, typically have two cotyledons, or seed leaves, and may also contain endosperm for extra food.
copy.tl: Ang mga buto ng angiosperm, tulad ng beans, ay karaniwang may dalawang cotyledon, o seed leaves, at maaari ring maglaman ng endosperm para sa karagdagang pagkain.
copy.bis: Ang mga liso sa angiosperm, sama sa beans, kasagarang adunay duha ka cotyledon, o seed leaves, ug mahimo usab nga adunay endosperm alang sa dugang nga pagkaon.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Tie back long hair before using heating tools like a Bunsen burner to prevent it from catching fire.
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe a valence electron as an electron in the outer shell of an atom that can take part in formation of bonds
assignedReviews.reason: The card is about laboratory safety (tying back hair to prevent fire) and has no instructional content about valence electrons, atomic structure, or chemical bonding. It does not support the competency in any way.

copy.en: Tie back long hair before using heating tools like a Bunsen burner to prevent it from catching fire.
copy.tl: Itali ang mahabang buhok bago gumamit ng heating tools tulad ng Bunsen burner para hindi ito masunog.
copy.bis: Ihigot ang taas nga buhok sa dili pa mogamit ug heating tools sama sa Bunsen burner aron dili kini masunog.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: A person with type B blood has either two B alleles (IBIB) or one B allele and one O allele (IBi)
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: use information from secondary sources to describe that living things interact with each other in the natural environment, such as through competition, or predation
assignedReviews.reason: ABO genotypes are genetics, not living things interacting through competition or predation.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: two B alleles (IBIB) or one B allele and one O allele (IBi)
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: describe the different ways that plants reproduce, such as pollination, seed production, and plant propagation
assignedReviews.reason: Human blood-type alleles are unrelated to how plants reproduce.

copy.en: A person with type B blood has either two B alleles (IBIB) or one B allele and one O allele (IBi).
copy.tl: Ang taong may type B na dugo ay may dalawang B alleles (IBIB) o isang B allele at isang O allele (IBi).
copy.bis: Ang tawo nga adunay type B nga dugo adunay duha ka B alleles (IBIB) o usa ka B allele ug usa ka O allele (IBi).

copy.tl: Ang tachycardia ay inuuri sa Atrial Tachycardia, na nagsisimula sa itaas na mga chamber ng puso, at Ventricular Tachycardia, na nagsisimula sa ibabang mga chamber.
copy.bis: Ang tachycardia giklasipikar ngadto sa Atrial Tachycardia, nga magsugod sa taas nga mga chamber sa kasingkasing, ug Ventricular Tachycardia, nga magsugod sa ubos nga mga chamber.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Natural disasters like typhoons and extreme weather are density-independent limiting factors
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: investigate and describe the relationship among the projectile variables including the angle and velocity of release, and projectile height and range, using everyday activities such as shooting basketballs or kicking footballs
assignedReviews.reason: The card discusses ecology/population dynamics (density-independent limiting factors), not projectile motion variables (angle, velocity, height, range). No instructional support for G10-F-1.

copy.en:
Can a typhoon wipe out a whole population of animals?

Yes, it can! Natural disasters like typhoons and extreme weather are density-independent limiting factors that affect populations regardless of their size.
copy.tl:
Kaya bang lipulin ng bagyo ang buong population ng mga hayop?

Oo, kaya nito! Ang mga natural disaster tulad ng bagyo at matinding panahon ay density-independent limiting factors na nakakaapekto sa population anuman ang laki nito.
copy.bis:
Makaya ba sa bagyo nga papason ang tibuok population sa mga mananap?

Oo, makaya kini! Ang mga natural disaster sama sa bagyo ug grabe nga panahon mga density-independent limiting factors nga makaapekto sa population bisan unsa pa ang gidak-on niini.

copy.en:
Does eating spicy food cause stomach ulcers?

No! Most ulcers are caused by a bacterial infection or certain medicines, not by spicy food.
copy.tl:
Nagdudulot ba ng stomach ulcers ang pagkain ng maanghang?

Hindi! Karamihan ng ulcers ay sanhi ng bacterial infection o ilang mga gamot, hindi ng maanghang na pagkain.
copy.bis:
Makapahinabo ba og stomach ulcers ang pagkaon og halang?

Dili! Kadaghanan sa mga ulcers gipahinabo sa bacterial infection o sa pipila ka mga tambal, dili sa halang nga pagkaon.

copy.en: In an Atwood machine, when one hanging mass is larger, the net force is unbalanced, so the larger mass accelerates downward and the smaller mass accelerates upward.
copy.tl: Sa isang Atwood machine, kapag mas malaki ang isang nakabiting mass, ang net force ay unbalanced, kaya ang mas malaking mass ay bumibilis pababa at ang mas maliit na mass ay bumibilis paitaas.
copy.bis: Sa usa ka Atwood machine, kon mas dako ang usa ka nagbitay nga mass, ang net force unbalanced, busa ang mas dako nga mass mopaspas paubos ug ang mas gamay nga mass mopaspas paitaas.

copy.bis: Kadaghanan sa mga komunidad mokuha sa ilang tubig gikan sa underground aquifers, nga mga rock formation nga makahimo sa pagtipig ug daghang freshwater.

copy.en: Uniform acceleration means equal changes in velocity happen in equal time intervals, like an athlete gaining 1.5 m/s every second during a race.
copy.tl: Ang uniform acceleration ay nangangahulugang pantay na pagbabago ng velocity sa pantay na pagitan ng oras, tulad ng isang atleta na nakakakuha ng 1.5 m/s bawat segundo habang tumatakbo sa karera.
copy.bis: Ang uniform acceleration nagpasabot nga parehas nga pagbag-o sa velocity mahitabo sa parehas nga gintang sa oras, sama sa usa ka atleta nga makakuha og 1.5 m/s matag segundo samtang nagdagan sa lumba.

copy.en: A uniform distribution pattern happens when organisms are spaced evenly apart, often because they compete for the same resources like water or space.
copy.tl: Ang uniform distribution pattern ay nangyayari kapag ang mga organismo ay pantay-pantay ang pagitan, kadalasan dahil nag-aagawan sila sa parehong resources tulad ng tubig o espasyo.
copy.bis: Ang uniform distribution pattern mahitabo kon ang mga organismo parehas og gilay-on, sagad tungod kay nag-indigay sila sa parehong resources sama sa tubig o espasyo.

assignedReviews.card_evidence: Plate tectonic theory is a unifying theory in geology
assignedReviews.competency_evidence: investigate and describe the relationship among the projectile variables including the angle and velocity of release, and projectile height and range, using everyday activities such as shooting basketballs or kicking footballs

copy.en: Plate tectonic theory is a unifying theory in geology because it explains how moving crustal plates create major structural features like mountains, trenches, and volcanoes.
copy.tl: Ang plate tectonic theory ay isang unifying theory sa geology dahil ipinapaliwanag nito kung paano lumilikha ang mga gumagalaw na crustal plate ng mga pangunahing structural feature tulad ng mga bundok, trench, at bulkan.
copy.bis: Ang plate tectonic theory usa ka unifying theory sa geology tungod kay nagpasabot kini kon giunsa sa mga naglihok nga crustal plate paghimo ug mga pangunang structural feature sama sa mga bukid, trench, ug bulkan.
